# evroc_virtual_machine_console_logs (Data Source)

Reads the last 1,000 VM console log lines for explicit troubleshooting. Logs are sensitive and are stored in Terraform state; protect state access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_virtual_machine_console_logs" "debug" {
  name = "application-vm"
}

output "console_logs" {
  value     = data.evroc_virtual_machine_console_logs.debug.logs
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Virtual machine name.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project containing the VM. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `logs` (List of String, Sensitive) Console log lines, in API order.
- `region` (String) Region selected by the provider configuration.
